summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) legs intersecting the skirt and petticoat, most clearly in cross_legged, high_kick, lie_back_elbows and sit_chair; (2) a large change in the front skirt/petticoat silhouette during sit_stand between frames 61 and 65, where the hem rises across the knees; and (3) an abrupt change in the bent leg's knee-to-ankle configuration in run between frames 8 and 9, especially in the 3/4 view. Without cloth physics, limited draping and stiff skirt shapes are expected, but visible body-through-cloth intersections remain defects. Most standing and upper-body poses hold their proportions well, with no clear tearing, exploding geometry or reversed joints. Temporal assessments are limited to the supplied sampled frames; apparent pops need confirmation in consecutive-frame playback.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Upper thighs and front skirt panel, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The exposed thighs emerge through the front skirt surface while the skirt continues beneath them; absent cloth physics explains the poor draping but leaves a clearly visible intersection.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Folded legs beneath the front hem
items.issue: The folded legs and small visible shoe sections crowd into the petticoat with locally ambiguous intersections, although the broad, undraped skirt is expected without physics.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh at the front of the skirt
items.issue: The raised thigh passes through the skirt panel instead of lifting its hem, leaving a conspicuous skin-to-fabric intersection in both views.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Both thighs, crossed lower legs and lap
items.issue: Both legs and the crossed shoes occupy the front of an otherwise continuous skirt, producing extensive body-through-cloth intersections rather than fabric settling around the lap.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Forward upper thigh and front skirt
items.issue: The forward thigh visibly exits through the skirt surface above the hem, particularly in the 3/4 view, although the leg itself retains a plausible bend.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Raised thigh beneath the lifted front hem
items.issue: The raised thigh presses into the petticoat edge with a small visible overlap, while the stiff skirt flare is consistent with the absence of cloth physics.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Raised thigh and underside of the skirt
items.issue: The lifted thigh meets the skirt underside in a compressed, slightly intersecting contour, most apparent in the 3/4 view.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Both knees and the front petticoat
items.issue: The tucked knees crowd into the petticoat and the skirt forms a stiff horizontal flare, with small contact intersections but no obvious limb collapse at this scale.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised thigh through the front skirt
items.issue: The kicking leg projects directly through the intact front skirt panel, especially clearly in the 3/4 view, rather than carrying the hem upward.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.location: Overlapping sleeves in front of the chest
items.issue: The inflated sleeves meet in a slightly merged central contour with little compression or separation, suggesting local cloth interpenetration.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Sleeve overlap across the upper chest
items.issue: The two sleeve volumes overlap into a broad, nearly continuous mass across the chest, with a small pinched junction rather than a convincing layered cloth contact.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Upper thighs and front skirt panel
items.issue: Both thighs emerge through the skirt while its front panel remains hanging below and between the legs, producing a conspicuous intersection in both views.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Hands against the crown and fringe
items.issue: The fingers appear partly embedded in the hair at the crown, making the hand-to-head contact slightly interpenetrating.

items.name: dance_clap
items.location: Hands and wrists directly beneath the chin
items.issue: The overlapping hands and cuffs form a crowded, slightly interpenetrating contact beneath the chin, without a clearly readable separation between the wrists.

items.name: run
items.location: Swing-leg knee and lower leg, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The tucked lower leg drops into a substantially straighter configuration over one frame, creating an apparent knee/ankle snap that should be checked in consecutive-frame playback.

items.name: sit_stand
items.issue: The seated thighs visibly penetrate the skirt, followed by a large front-hem lift between frames 61 and 65 that abruptly changes the exposed petticoat and knee coverage.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Raised thigh and front petticoat during the running-style accent
items.issue: The lifted thigh slightly intersects the underside of the flared petticoat, most visibly in the 3/4 view, while the sampled poses show no clear body-volume failure.
